exact_text_blocks.text: Lesson 3 of 7
Trace one action through the relay
Select each state to inspect what changed and what still does not follow. The sequence is deliberately granular because every boundary has a different owner and failure mode.
source-backed order
compressed teaching trace
Context before you trace
This timeline begins after the route is ready

Strategy, the exact route, material confirmation, route validation, and host preflight sit upstream of this lesson. The trace starts at one persisted action so you can follow a single work ticket without losing the causal edges around it.

Planning creates the ticket; the host stage attempts it; terminal accounting closes the worker; evidence handling admits and joins the result; the gate decides one transition. A dependent action then re-enters the same lifecycle—planning it is not closeout.
Connect this lesson to the repository
arcanum/runtime/orchestrate/tests/evidence-order/fixtures/valid-ordered.jsonl provides a complete public causal-order fixture.
This page compresses a real wave into one teaching trace. Valid order does not prove semantic truth, and a passing gate does not execute dependent work.
Action persisted — what changed
One exact work ticket now binds the role, inputs, outputs, and write boundaries.
The host has not been called and no worker has started.
↺ Dependent work repeats the lifecycle — A newly planned action returns to attempt, host result, terminal accounting, receipt admission, join, and its declared gate.
↓ Closeout requires a terminal branch — Only terminal resolution or an explicit stop reaches closeout. Planning alone is not a terminal event.
No lifecycle state inspected yet.

timeline_states.limit: The host has not been called and no worker has started.

timeline_states.changed: The causal record now says the parent intends to invoke this exact action.
timeline_states.limit: An attempt is not host acceptance or worker creation.

timeline_states.changed: A native worker binding or explicit spawn failure is now attributable to the attempt.
timeline_states.limit: A started worker has not necessarily completed.

timeline_states.changed: Wait, terminal observation, and one logical close account for the worker.
timeline_states.limit: Returned work is not yet an admitted or joined receipt.

timeline_states.changed: The exact expected receipt files, required shape, and run/action identity have been checked.
timeline_states.limit: Referenced artifact bytes are not automatically proven, and the receipt has not joined.

timeline_states.changed: The admitted result can now participate in the wave reduction.
timeline_states.limit: The gate has not necessarily passed and the content is not semantic truth.

timeline_states.changed: The declared evidence condition either opens one transition or stops it explicitly.
timeline_states.limit: A passed gate does not execute dependent work; a fresh persisted plan is still required.

timeline_states.changed: Exact actions now exist for the newly eligible dependent wave.
timeline_states.limit: Those actions have not yet been attempted. They re-enter the action lifecycle rather than flowing directly to closeout.

timeline_states.limit: Closeout does not imply canonical status, publication, deployment, production, or truth.

exact_text_blocks.text: Lesson 1 of 7
Choose the smallest responsible shape
Before adding roles, gates, and receipts, decide whether the work actually needs them. Governance is useful when it protects a real boundary—not when it merely makes the diagram larger.
source-backed distinction
teaching scenarios
Why it matters before you choose
Start with the decision that needs protection

You have an objective, but you do not have a route yet. If one worker can return one clear result and the parent can inspect it directly, the coordination problem is still small. A larger agent team would add handoffs without protecting a new decision.
A governed dispatch earns that extra machinery when independent viewpoints, producer/reviewer separation, parallel results, dependency gates, or isolated write scopes are part of the problem itself.
Diagnostic: if you removed the extra roles, what important boundary would disappear? If none would, begin with one bounded helper.
Connect this lesson to the repository
arcanum/arcana/subagent-strategy/SKILL.md describes the dispatch trigger, material confirmation, and lifecycle boundaries.
Choosing a dispatch shape does not authorize, register, or execute it. More agents create more explicit boundaries, not more authority.
A parent needs one helper to locate the schema that owns a failing field and report the exact line. The parent will inspect the result.
Two independent reviewers must challenge a proposal. Implementation may begin only after both receipts join and a named gate passes.
Check both decisions
Next: find the proof →

exact_text_blocks.text: Lesson 7 of 7
Transfer the method to an unseen handoff
Closed questions can test encoded distinctions. This exit ticket asks you to produce the mechanism yourself. Your text is preserved for human review; the browser does not grade its meaning.
Context before you transfer the method
Rebuild only the local transition you were given

You do not need to retell the whole runtime. Identify the bounded input and admitted state, the named owner and evidence rule, the immediate consequence, and the later limit or next owner. That four-part chain is enough to inspect a much larger workflow.

Write from the scenario's evidence without supplying a missing action or turning one transition into a larger truth claim. The prompts below scaffold the structure, but they deliberately do not provide a model answer.
Connect this lesson to the repository
arcanum/runtime/orchestrate/scripts/native_dispatch_driver.py owns receipt admission and live wave advancement around this kind of gate boundary.
Non-empty fields establish only that text was stored locally. They do not prove comprehension, independent orchestration ability, authorization, or semantic truth.
Scenario: two review receipts were admitted and joined. Their gate passed. The repository contains no persisted action for the implementation wave.
Input or situation
What bounded task and evidence state did you receive?
Transformation and present state
What owner-controlled rule changed the state?
Immediate consequence and missing step
What became eligible, and what must exist before execution?
Next owner and later limit
Who owns the next move, and what would still remain unproved?
Save the exit ticket
Human gate remains: non-empty text proves only that the fields were filled. An intended-reader review must judge whether your answer preserves state, evidence, owner, and residue correctly.

claim_limits.text: Choosing a dispatch shape does not authorize, register, or execute it. More agents create more explicit boundaries, not more authority.
Receipt admission checks expected files, shape, and action/run identity. It does not prove referenced artifact contents, join, gate passage, or semantic truth.
This page compresses a real wave into one teaching trace. Valid order does not prove semantic truth, and a passing gate does not execute dependent work.
The displayed object is shortened and not schema-valid by itself. Persisting or inspecting an action proves preparation, not host acceptance, execution, or compliance.
A blocking order error establishes an invalid transition. It does not prove the worker's substantive result false or invalidate earlier correctly recorded evidence.
The page only copies text. It has no shell, collaboration, host, or network bridge, and the question is answerable without running a command.

questions.correct_feedback: Yes. One bounded, inspectable result does not yet justify a dispatch.
questions.incorrect_feedback: Look for a real need for independent judgment, parallelism, isolation, or dependent gates. None is present here.
questions.legend: What is the smallest responsible shape?

questions.correct_feedback: Right. Independence plus a dependent gate justifies the governed route.
questions.incorrect_feedback: One helper would collapse independent review and the dependent gate into one responsibility.
questions.legend: What shape does this task require?

questions.correct_feedback: Correct. The gate reduces the declared receipts only after they have been admitted and joined.
questions.incorrect_feedback: A host result and receipt admission are earlier states. The gate consumes joined receipts.
questions.legend: What evidence state must precede the gate decision in this trace?

options.receipt-joined: Every required receipt was admitted and joined

questions.correct_feedback: Yes. Eligibility is not execution; the dependent work still needs exact persisted actions.
questions.incorrect_feedback: A passing gate opens one declared transition. It cannot create, attempt, or execute the dependent action by implication.
questions.legend: A gate passed. What is still required before the dependent worker can start?

options.new-plan: A fresh persisted action plan for the eligible wave
options.nothing: Nothing; gate passage starts the worker
options.truth: Proof that the earlier receipt is semantically true

questions.legend: May an implementation worker begin now?

options.no: No; the gate creates eligibility, but an exact action must still be persisted
options.yes: Yes; the passing gate starts dependent work
